pageDescription: Worked on several websites for Toro that include Smartyard, Flexorce and Revolution.
fbOgSiteName: A Fort Worth based developer who makes unique web experiences.
workDescription: The Toro Smartyard website is designed to showcase their new robotic mower and other innovative products. In the initial phase of the project, there were various missing pieces that needed to be completed. I addressed these gaps by building the required sections, adding functional enhancements to specific blocks and refining the user interface to provide a more seamless user experience.
workDescription2: Toro Revolution is a website that showcases their electric powered landscaping products. I was tasked to maintain this website on a monthly basis, keeping it up to date and addressed any technical glitches. Along with improving the user interface and created a form that finds the nearest dealer.
workDescription3: Toro Flexforce is a website that promotes their 60v battery that can plug into almost any Toro electric device. I was tasked to maintain this website on a monthly basis, such as keeping it up to date and resolving any bugs. made some functional tweaks and enhancements for the  product heros, sliders and performed several UI enhancements throughout the sites.
workTechnology: WordPress, PHP, Gutenberg, ACF, WPML, Javascript
